projectMove.body: Yesterday the site picked up real Core 1 lesson content on page one, plus the Virtualization domain growing to 90 questions, and all of it is live. The one open piece is Miyuki's second pass on Domain 5, Troubleshooting, along with her Virtualization audit. Getting both reviewed and merged this week means the course is in a clean, finished state before you board on Saturday.

tip.title: Keep your boarding pass on your phone offline
tip.body: Check-in is done, with boarding group C02 and an 11:00 to 11:30 AM arrival in Tampa. Save the boarding pass PDF to your phone's files and keep your passport card with it, so port day does not depend on cell signal or an app login at the terminal.

extras.cruiseNote: The trip runs October 31 to November 5. The Tallahassee bus leaves the night of October 31, the ship sails from Tampa on November 1, and Cozumel on November 3 (about 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM) is the one shore day. Express Debarkation is a separate step set for November 4.
extras.weatherNote: Clear and dry, starting near 56F this morning with a high near 79F and no rain expected. Sunset is 6:54 PM, with golden light from about 6:20 PM.

surprise.title: Tonight's light is perfect from about 6:20 to 6:54 PM
surprise.body: The sun sets at 6:54 PM in Tallahassee tonight, and the warm, low golden light starts around 6:20 PM. The forecast shows clear skies through the whole window with no rain chance, and it should be about 75°F at 6 PM, cooling to about 71°F by 7. Blue hour follows from roughly 7:09 to 7:18 PM, which is the soft, even light that flatters grad portraits. With the ship sailing in five days, this is one of the last clear evenings to grab a Grad Arena shot or simply enjoy a sunset at home before the trip.
